milestones.outcome: An unconfigured source Git repository can explicitly bind a managed or supplied external tracker, then resolve that binding through an observational public command while leaving the source untouched.
exit_criteria: Public setup and status paths bind the same Git common repository across worktrees, preserve explicit mode precedence, and refuse absent or unsafe bindings.
Disposable source repositories show zero workflow-generated source and Git-directory changes after setup and observation; supplied and managed tracker cases pass.
Existing project-mode context and two linked consumer paths still resolve their original project facts.
milestones.boundary: The first usable personal selection and read path proves the storage boundary before relocating the full board and commit lifecycle.

milestones.outcome: The shared public RFC lifecycle runs through paired tracker records and source commits, with privacy and crash recovery enforced.
exit_criteria: Plan intake, claim, verify, source commit, interrupt, resume and closeout use the shared public helpers with portable tracker records and local runtime receipts.
Paired lanes, reservations, source/tracker revision handoff, source-message and publication privacy, and pre/post commit failure recovery pass direct disposable tests.
Project-mode planning, board, partial acceptance, stale return, human-pending and closeout regressions remain passing.
milestones.boundary: Private records and product effects become one recoverable user workflow rather than isolated storage primitives.

milestones.outcome: Personal native roles, MASK scope-specific readiness and companion workflows use the same bound external state.
exit_criteria: The canonical role definitions render at personal scope with assignment-provided project facts; MASK personal readiness is integrated at its actual program revision without persistent approval.
Attended-review, wizard and compatible remote handoffs route runtime state externally and protect source candidates; incompatible adapters refuse before writes.
Instruction tabletop and disposable scope tests cover first use, resume, small fix, status-only and paired worktrees in both modes.
milestones.boundary: The personal workflow becomes usable by the selected hosts and companion procedures without a second orchestration fork.

milestones.outcome: The complete private workflow is qualified across offline/native paths and truthfully closed at the selected adoption boundary.
exit_criteria: Complete private run, footprint, paired lanes, recovery, synchronization and behavior parity satisfy the original mandate with direct evidence.
Actual Codex and Claude Code personal-role loading and bounded source/external-state operation are evidenced, or required criteria remain explicitly pending.
Every RFC criterion has actual revision/evidence on the closeout, selected adoption is ownership-safe, and no unrelated consumer or private product metadata is changed.
milestones.boundary: Final acceptance needs the composed offline and native behavior, with unresolved requirements kept open.
